note: Weekday slots. Mon=withheld, Tue=the false yes, Wed=residue, Thu=load and the practical future, Fri=closeness. Rotates by week; edit freely.

1.q: Is there anything one of us decided not to trouble the other with this weekend?
1.eg: I noticed something was off with you on Sunday and decided not to ask.

1.q: Was there a moment this weekend when one of us almost said something and didn't?
1.eg: I nearly said I was tired on Saturday and then let it go.

1.q: Did either of us notice something and choose not to ask about it?
1.eg: You were quiet after a phone call and I didn't ask who it was.

1.q: Was there a small thing this weekend that bothered one of us and stayed unsaid?
1.eg: The kitchen was left in a state and I decided it wasn't worth mentioning.

1.q: Did one of us want something this weekend and not ask for it?
1.eg: I wanted a slow morning and didn't say so, and we went out early.

1.q: Was there a worry one of us carried through the weekend alone?
1.eg: I was thinking about a deadline the whole of Sunday and never said it.

1.q: Did either of us hold back a question this weekend to keep things easy?
1.eg: I wondered about something you said on Friday and never came back to it.

1.q: Was there something one of us wanted to talk about, but the moment never felt right?
1.eg: I meant to raise something on Sunday evening and the evening was too nice.

1.q: Did one of us feel something shift this weekend and let it pass?
1.eg: Something changed in the room on Saturday and neither of us named it.

1.q: Was there anything one of us left out when telling the other about the week?
1.eg: I made my week sound easier than it was.

1.q: Did either of us keep a disappointment to ourselves this weekend?
1.eg: I had hoped we would go for a walk and said nothing when we didn't.

1.q: Was there a moment one of us needed something and decided it could wait?
1.eg: I needed to talk on Saturday night and thought it could wait until later.

1.q: Did one of us protect the other from something this weekend?
1.eg: I kept a piece of bad news to myself so the weekend would stay light.

1.q: Was there anything one of us was afraid would sound ungrateful, so it stayed unsaid?
1.eg: I wanted a quieter day and worried that saying so would sound unkind.

1.q: Did either of us have a second thought this weekend that never made it into words?
1.eg: I wondered afterwards whether I had been short with you.

1.q: Was there something one of us noticed about the other and kept private?
1.eg: You seemed tired in a way that wasn't just sleep, and I said nothing.

1.q: Did one of us decide a feeling was too small to mention this weekend?
1.eg: A small thing stung on Sunday and I told myself it was nothing.

1.q: Is there anything from this weekend one of us is still deciding whether to say?
1.eg: There's something I've started to write twice and deleted.

2.q: Did one of us say “it's fine” this week when it wasn't quite fine?

2.q: Where did one of us push past being tired this week instead of saying so?
2.eg: I kept going on Wednesday evening when I should have stopped.

2.q: Did one of us take on something this week that wasn't ours to carry?

2.q: Was there a moment one of us said “no problem” and there was a small problem?

2.q: Where did one of us give an answer we thought was wanted rather than true?
